confidence_notes: Recent Numbeo Havana averages put an inexpensive meal near $4, a mid-range meal for two near $28, draft beer near $1.60 and cappuccino near $1.10. The July price window is approximate; local and visitor prices can differ sharply amid Cuba's volatility. Cocktail and wine estimates use tourist-bar price levels relative to beer; accommodation estimates are holistic.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation is estimated around the Trinidad, Cuba three-star benchmark, above Medellín and Paracas and below Puerto Natales. Havana's capital and visitor demand support a similar three-star rate, while its larger supply suggests lower basic guesthouse prices than Trinidad.
